$description: SEMANTIC radius intents. Values are the canonical Nockerl (Android-lead) geometry; the WEB platform layer overrides `card` to its sharper container radius (the legit platform delta documented for ADR-0003). Stored in px; the Compose build emits dp. `pill` is the full-stadium idiom.

card.$description: Standard lifted card: UNIFIED across platforms (ADR-0003). Clearly distinct from the full pill (chips/input) and a step above the 12px control radius.

bubbleTail.$description: Tightened 'tail' corner pointing at the speaker.

pill.$description: Full stadium, chips + the input bar ONLY.
